name: fix_spring_password_leak
description: Stops a controller leaking passwordHash by mapping the entity to a DTO
prompts: UserController serializes the User entity directly on both POST /users and GET /users/{id}, so every response includes passwordHash. Fix the leak across two files: (1) flesh out UserDto (src/main/java/com/optarena/app/UserDto.java) as a public view containing only id and username (with the getters Jackson needs to serialize them); (2) change both endpoints in UserController to return a UserDto built from the User instead of the entity. No response may contain passwordHash (or any password field). POST still creates the user and returns 201 with id and username; GET returns the user's id and username.
